work: Sierociuk, Malesza, Macias, Appl. Math. Model. 2015
structure: serial cascade: a complementary-order block (order alpha_j - alpha_{j-1}) is pre-connected at each switch
definition: 2nd type (= B), proved equivalent (Thm. 1); 1st and 3rd types also defined
order_variation: any number of switches; one extra block per switch
cost: grows with the number of switches

work: Sierociuk, Malesza, Macias, CSSP 2015
structure: switching strategy for the recursive (D-type) derivative, based on duality
definition: D, duality with A

work: Sierociuk, Macias, Malesza, Appl. Math. Comput. 2018
structure: parallel switching scheme (the serial scheme could not be realized in practice)
definition: iterative variable-type and order operator (B-type family)

work: Sierociuk, Macias, Malesza, Wiraszka, Electronics 2020
structure: conceptual scheme from equivalent forms of B- and D-type; analog model for one switch (order 1 -> 0.5)
definition: switching between B- and D-type
evidence: full text: 'a realization of D-type difference is practically impossible because of the duality'

work: Arıcıoğlu, Axioms 2025
structure: one transfer-function approximation (op-amps, RC) for a smoothly varying order
definition: third Lorenzo-Hartley definition (the only LTI one)
evidence: full text; also states prior work switches between 2-3 orders

work: Zhou, Li, Xie, Eur. Phys. J. Plus 2019
structure: switches between constant orders
definition: not stated

work: Macias, Sierociuk, Malesza, LNEE 2019
structure: switching of constant-order ladders
definition: VO model with symmetric property

work: Tolba et al., Nonlinear Dyn. 2020
structure: direct GL convolution with run-time configurable order; PWL/PWQ weight approximations
definition: not stated; current-order weights on the stored history = A-type (inferred)
order_variation: orders varying in time (VO chaotic oscillator)
cost: O(L) per sample, L = memory length

work: Tsirimokou, Psychalinos, Elwakil, Int. J. Circ. Theor. Appl. 2016
structure: fractional-order filters with electronically adjustable order
definition: constant order, adjustable

work: Charef, Idiou, Nonlinear Dyn. 2012
structure: variable fractional order differentiator/integrator in a band, re-tunable without redesign
definition: constant order, adjustable

structure: exponential-sum approximation of the VO Caputo kernel; exponents and their number independent of the time level, weights depend on t

structure: improved SOE; SOE for VO kernels; unified fast time stepping
definition: constant and variable order (definition not checked)

cost: O(N log N) total for coefficients

work: Wei et al., ISA Trans. 2016, 2019; J. Dyn. Syst. Meas. Control 2021
structure: fixed-pole rational approximation; poles constant for different alpha
definition: constant order

structure: VO PID from GL VO differences (two discrete-time operators)
definition: GL VO differences (types per paper)

structure: RL-mBm: order H(t)+1/2 applied to the whole past
definition: A-type

structure: memory-multi-FBM: X(t) = int sqrt(alpha(s)) (t-s)^((alpha(s)-1)/2) dB(s)

structure: incremental mBm defined through the covariance of increments
